title: SE1 pressure contacts — source selection and one aligned stop
status: Prepared; in-engine integration and human listening pending

rights.basis: Existing repository license trail; no new download, service, voice or generated performance.

selection.operation: Existing asset, unchanged; fixed far fixture emitter.
Existing asset, unchanged; fixed middle service joint emitter.
Preserve source frames 7968..37439 (0.166..0.780 s), 3 ms linear attack and 10 ms linear release; unchanged pitch/peak and no added gain. 24-bit PCM retained.

integrationIntent.emission: Four fixed lower-frame emitters at z=3/7/11/15, gains 0.42/0.46/0.34/0.34, WorldSFX, spatialBlend 1, dopplerLevel 0. Existing listener/options/pause owner; no head-locked layer.
integrationIntent.synchronization: Far source starts 0.18 s before its stop, middle starts 0.44 s before its stop. Near sources start at their shared physical stop; trimmed maximum is +13.542 ms. Per-frame motion/audio dispatch requires central Editor review.
integrationIntent.composition: Far captive shutter -> middle captive shutter -> two near observation shutters closing together as one beat, with shrinking distance, brief gaps and persistent visual closure. No music, random schedule, repeated flash or Echo sound.
integrationIntent.level: Asset peak is unchanged from the existing frame contact. Start conservatively in the scene; do not compensate distant attenuation by raising global mix. Master options/mono/reduced dynamics remain authoritative.

objectiveChecks: Main-project read-only source hashes matched the tracked master manifests.
All selected masters inspected as mono, 48 kHz, 24-bit PCM.
New asset sample count, fades, peak, RMS, maximum offset and SHA256 measured directly.
No Unity Editor, import, Play, playback audition or device listening performed.
critique: A 0.18 s unsynchronized start on the original frame contact would separate picture from impact. The trim fixes that onset; fear still depends on the plate moving into near peripheral space and a readable retreat path. Three similar distant clicks alone would reproduce the old weakness.
humanQuestions: Does the near plate stop read as physical material reaching the Player, including on speakers?
Is the withdrawal direction immediately readable at comfortable volume with camera free?
